description: Header file declaring the NarratorNotifier class, which manages narrator announcements within the Calculator app's automation framework. It provides properties and methods to handle narrator announcements and dependency property registration.

classes.name: NarratorNotifier
classes.description: A sealed class that manages narrator announcements for accessibility automation, derived from DependencyObject, with properties and methods to handle announcement logic.

methods.name: Announce
methods.description: Method to trigger a narrator announcement with the specified NarratorAnnouncement object.

methods.name: RegisterDependencyProperties
methods.description: Static method to register dependency properties used by the NarratorNotifier class.

methods.name: GetAnnouncement
methods.description: Static method to retrieve the current NarratorAnnouncement from a DependencyObject.

methods.name: SetAnnouncement
methods.description: Static method to set a NarratorAnnouncement on a DependencyObject.

methods.name: OnAnnouncementChanged
methods.description: Static callback invoked when the Announcement property changes.
